successors.note: Li Xiaogong destroyed Xiao Xian's state in 621 and many of Xiao's troops joined Lin; Lin died in 622 and 'his followers scattered, ending his state of Chu'. The Transition page has the Chu dissolved before spring 623.

ledger.note: 617: Lin Shihong claims the title of Emperor of Chu. 'Around the new year 617, Lin claimed the title of Emperor of Chu' (era Taiping, 22 January 617); he had followed the rebel Cao Shiqi in 616 and fought Liu Ziyi at Poyang Lake.

618: Yuzhang falls to Xiao Xian's general. The Xiao Xian page: 'Around the new year 618' his general Su Hu'er attacked Lin's major city Yuzhang; the Lin Shihong page has Su Hu'er capture Yuzhang, 'prompting Lin to further retreat to Yugan', without a date. [Reviewer ea-03-f, 2026-10-19: source moved to the Xiao Xian page: the Lin Shihong page does not date the capture (its 'around the new year 618' belongs to Zhang Shan'an's earlier attack)]

region.text: the Chu without the Yuzhang (Nanchang) plain taken by Su Hu'er

ledger.note: 622: the Chu ends with Lin Shihong's death. In winter 622 he offered to surrender, regretted it and fled to Ancheng; 'Lin soon died, and his followers scattered, ending his state of Chu.' The Tang took Jiangxi and Guangdong; the page names no date or commander for that.

wars.name: Lin Shihong's war with Xiao Xian
wars.outcome: Su Hu'er took Yuzhang for Xiao Xian around new year 618 and Lin retreated; after the Tang destroyed Xiao in 621 Lin died in 622 and the Chu scattered.

certainty.note: A province-span realm with shifting seats; the page gives no boundary.

notes: REBEL STATE. The Transition page ends the Chu 'before spring 623' after Lin's death; the Lin page has him dying in 622. The Tang dossier's text name is 'Lin Shihong (Chu)'; use this slug.
